entities.name: UniProt P28607 Arylsulfatase
observations: Reviewed Pseudoalteromonas carrageenovora arylsulfatase; the query sequence is an exact 100% identity and 100% coverage match.
N-terminal residues 1–25 form a signal peptide; the mature enzyme spans residues 26–328 and is associated with the periplasm.
May function as a glycosulphohydrolase involved in desulfation of sulfated polysaccharides.

entities.name: Aryl sulfate hydrolysis
observations: An aryl sulfate ester reacts with water to form the corresponding phenol, sulfate, and H+.
Reaction is annotated as EC 3.1.6.1 and Rhea RHEA:17261.

entities.name: P28607 sequence properties
observations: Protein length is 328 residues and predicted molecular mass is 35,792 Da.
The sequence contains Pfam Lactamase_B, Anti-Pycsar_Apyc1, and Lactamase_B_2 domain hits.
